summary: Recent advancements in AI include TrustedRouter's successful $1.25 million funding round, and Chatham Financial's integration of OpenAI's Codex and GPT-5.6, which has significantly reduced trade validation time. Google DeepMind unveiled Gemini 4 Argon, advancing AI capabilities, while Microsoft Research developed a machine learning system to predict space weather risks to power grids, enhancing infrastructure resilience. Additionally, OpenAI released a guide for startups on effectively utilizing the GPT-6 models, aimed at optimizing AI applications in business.
recommendations: Focus on the most impactful news items that highlight significant advancements in AI and technology.
Emphasize funding news, product launches, and major research developments that have practical implications.

items.original: Forecasting space weather risks on power grids. Extreme space-weather events can damage power systems on Earth and degrade GPS accuracy and satellite operations. A new machine learning system can predict where damage is likely to occur 30-60 minutes before a storm arrives. The post Forecasting space weather risks on power grids appeared first on Microsoft Research .
items.rewritten: Microsoft Research has developed a machine learning system to forecast risks from space weather on power grids. This system can predict potential damage to power systems and disruptions to GPS and satellite operations 30-60 minutes before a storm hits. Such advancements are crucial for improving infrastructure resilience against extreme space weather events.
